title: BDC launches LIFT — a C$500M AI push for SMEs
blurb: The question is no longer whether AI belongs in an SME's business plan, but how. BDC commits half a billion to move firms from intention to action.
body:
The Business Development Bank of Canada (BDC) launched LIFT, a C$500M program to help small and mid-sized enterprises move "from intention to action" on AI and concretely raise productivity.

The framing: today the question isn't whether AI should be part of an SME's business plan, but how it gets implemented — yet too many SMEs struggle to take the first step. One of the biggest brakes on adoption is simply not knowing where to start or how to extract value.

SOURCE · Isabelle Hudon (President & CEO, BDC), LinkedIn.
